Notes

Ghazbaran - the "Lord of Blades", is a member of the Triangle of Terror. The cultists in the Formorgar Mines are said to be trying to revive the frozen demons in there to conjure the mighty archdemon. They are melting the ice in his name.

  1. 00:00:00: An ancient evil is awakening in the mines beneath Hrodmir.
  2. 00:10:00: Demonic entities are entering the mortal realm in the Hrodmir mines.
  3. 00:20:00: The demonic master has revealed itself in the mines of Hrodmir.

The first time he appeared after the test server was on the server of Julera on July 4, 2007.
The first time he died was on the server of Candia on September 22, 2007.

Ghazbaran can be seen with at least 5 Deathslicers, 2 Juggernauts, 2 Furies, and 1 Demon. The furies and demon appear to spawn with Ghazbaran, along with some of the deathslicers. Some of the deathslicer are summoned by Ghazbaran.

Location

Formorgar Mines, in the pit with the Juggernaut.

Behaviour

Ghazbaran runs away in low health. He also casts a defense spell on himself which will temporarily reduce every attacker's skill (depending on what he hits with) to 0. He will only remain in the realm for 4 hours.
